assessments.reasoning: The custom types chapter directly states that variants can carry their own associated data. Its User and Msg examples contain variants with different payload shapes, including plain constructors with no associated data.

challenge.method: Compare the multi-argument, single-argument and payloadless examples in the same declaration. Compare the surrounding text with the distinct type-alias construct.
challenge.results: Varied payloads are defined on the variants themselves. The examples require no record wrapper and establish no allocation or representation semantics.

limitations: The claim concerns the documented custom type construct and leaves representation and storage unassessed.
